newsitem.title: UK: HK stocks drop in London as Greenspan rattles Dow.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks drop in London as Greenspan rattles Dow.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London dropped on Wednesday as dealers marked down prices in line with a sharp fall on Wall Street, after U.S. Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan repeated his warning over exuberant stock markets.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was 106.15 points or 0.8 percent lower at 13,435.68 by 1555 GMT, after the Hang Seng in Hong Kong ended some 21.57 points or 0.16 percent higher.

"We haven't seen a lot of selling. It's just a markdown across the board," said one trader in Hong Kong stocks here. The Dow dropped almost 100 points at one stage before rebounding to be down just 59.64 points at 6,978.57 by 1558 GMT.
